newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: W. Australia passes controversial labour bill.
newsitem.headline: W. Australia passes controversial labour bill.

text.p: The Western Australian state government's labour relations legislation amendment bill passed through the Legislative Council on Thursday after further debate on the controversial legislation was guillotined.
The bill now only requires ratification in the Legislative Assembly before becoming law.
Earlier on Thursday a trade union sit-in in the councils' public gallery forced a change of venue and the final debate an vote took place in the select committee room.
The bill allows for for pre-strike secret ballots and limits union accss to the work place.
Trades and Labour Council secretary Tony Cooke said the union movement will start "the next phase of its protest campaign" on Friday against the bill.
Protest over the last three weeks have been marked by rolling work stoppages that have affected power supplies, petrol distribution, milk deliveries and shipping.
